card_resolution: Shallow merge mission_defaults with one mission entry for review only; no runtime parsing or activation is implemented by this file.

mission_defaults.write_scope: Only existing owners named by the completed source review; new scope requires operator activation.
inputs: Exact source bytes and required read closure
Per-run conversation/mission/generation/session bindings before dependent effects

provider.selection: Existing ai_platform driver/capability registry, after source and availability validation

lpcl.blocking_input: Full phase contract/operator/provider/evaluator and panel ingress closure

mission_defaults.readback: Read exact artifact bytes and original producer/consumer result; reconcile with source digest and bound identities.

effect_gates.pr_publication: Within this authoring task, separate branch only

budget.unknown_budget_policy: Must bind a finite budget before execution, not an open-ended run

stop_conditions: Unresolved source/scope/authority/provider binding for dependent effect
Failed negative control or wrong provenance
Unknown effect: reconcile, do not blind retry
mission_defaults.rollback: Preserve rejected generation and evidence; revert only the new candidate commit before integration. Deployment and non-reversible effects require separately designed compensation.
mission_defaults.terminal_result: Evidence-bound candidate or explicit unresolved dependency; never a fabricated mission COMPLETE.
